h6dynastyweaponsRumor0.text: I hear ancient dynasty weapons slumber at the Dynasty Weaponsmith. A hero of level 10 or higher can claim one there, but if you already carry a dynasty weapon, don't expect to get another.

h6dynastyweaponsRumor1.text: They say a hero holding the Pirate King's Sword sends his whole army's Morale sky-high at the start of battle. The trick is called Endless Rum, but sadly there isn't a drop of rum to drink.

h6dynastyweaponsRumor2.text: I hear once the Sword of the Wolf is drawn, neither hero can retreat or surrender.

h6dynastyweaponsRumor3.text: Legend says one wave of the Dragonbone Staff and Ghost Dragons come flocking to help. They're only temporary help, though, and scatter once the battle is over.
